arguments.value: This agreement says StartEngine will provide the customer a platform to present its securities offering online, let users create accounts, view the offering, show interest, and submit subscription agreements and payment instructions. In return, the customer must pay monthly service fees, transaction fees, AML fees, and reimburse related processing, escrow, credit card, and return/reversal costs. The customer is responsible for user activity and any ACH reversals or chargebacks, and StartEngine can collect those amounts from escrow or the customer’s bank account. The agreement lasts for the duration of the offering unless ended earlier, and either party can terminate for uncured breach, misrepresentation, bankruptcy or insolvency events, material legal or regulatory changes, financial deterioration, or force majeure lasting more than 10 business days.
